objective: Demonstrate mapping explicit OpenAI/Anthropic/generic usage into recorded calls.
limitations: Exact model calls are counted from recorded modelCalls.
Exact token count is summed only from explicit per-call token fields.
Exact cost is summed only from explicit per-call costUsd fields.
Recorded latency is captured per call (total ≈ 5300 ms) but not yet represented in the normalized schema.
exact_energy_wh stays null; energy/heat remain configurable estimates, not recorder-measured.
Waste labels remain detector/heuristic findings, not provider measurements.
Note: Synthetic demo session built with Recorder Lite + provider usage mappers.
Note: Token counts and costs are illustrative demo values, not measured production usage.
